title: ARIRANG World Tour Returns to North America With Two Nights at MetLife Stadium
detail: August 1-2, 2026 — BTS opens the North American return leg of the ARIRANG World Tour with two nights at MetLife Stadium in East Rutherford, New Jersey — the same venue where they performed the World Cup Final halftime show two weeks earlier. The shows feature a 360-degree rotating stage inspired by traditional Korean architecture, blending newer ARIRANG-era tracks like 'Hooligan,' 'Aliens,' 'SWIM,' and 'Body to Body' with catalogue staples including 'Butter,' 'Dynamite,' 'IDOL,' 'FAKE LOVE,' 'MIC Drop,' and 'Fire.'

media.caption: BTS opens the North American return leg of the ARIRANG World Tour with two sold-out nights at MetLife Stadium.
